capabilities: Display .inkd notes page by page with zoom and pan
Embed handwritten notes in Markdown with a first-page preview
Search handwriting text saved by the iPad app
Open notes, PDFs and images in the Inkidian iPad app for editing and annotation
Create new notes in Inkidian from Obsidian
extras: The iPad app is free for 14 days, then a one-time purchase; live preview is experimental, Mac-only and off by default; the .inkd format is plain JSON with a public spec in format/SPEC.md.
motivation: Drawing plugins draw inside a web view, so the author built a native PencilKit app to keep the line right under the Apple Pencil.
problem: Obsidian displays and searches only Markdown, so handwritten notes and PDF annotations saved in the vault stay invisible there.

relations.evidence: one tap opens a note in Inkidian so you can keep writing

requires.name: Inkidian for iPad (one-time purchase after 14-day trial)

summary: Viewer for Inkidian handwritten notes that shows .inkd files and PDF ink in Obsidian and opens them in the iPad app for writing.
